The cited evidence does not support these claims: E1 discusses static grain refinement from cold rolling and its negative impact on corrosion, not dynamic refinement under sliding; E2 addresses boron microalloying effects on wear and corrosion, not deformation-induced amorphization; E3 mentions low friction in UHV but does not link it to grain refinement or passive film disruption in corrosive environments. Thus, the key premise
premises: Sliding wear induces dynamic grain refinement and amorphization in HEAs
Grain refinement/amorphization lowers friction and wear
Mechanical deformation disrupts the passive oxide film
Disrupted passive film leads to accelerated localized corrosion
Net degradation is governed by competition between reduced wear and enhanced corrosion
